units.source_text: 啊，那双我本以为再也不能睁开的眼睛睁开了。

en.t: Ah, the eyes I had thought would never open again opened.

units.source_text: 我简直高兴得像一道亮光射进了黑暗的世界。

en.t: I was so happy it was as if a beam of light had shot into a dark world.

units.source_text: （倒不是想祖父的瞎眼能够治好，

en.t: It was not that I thought Grandfather's blind eyes could be cured,

units.source_text: 当时祖父双目紧闭，我忐忑不安，

en.t: but at that moment Grandfather's eyes were tightly shut, and I was anxious,

units.source_text: 担心他会不会就那样长眠下去。）

en.t: worried that he might go on sleeping forever just like that.)
